# Agent Budget Guard
Agent Budget Guard is a lightweight API for controlling AI-agent spending before paid API calls.

Use this API when an AI agent is about to call a paid API, trigger an x402 payment, or spend USDC / JPYC.

Core use case:
Check whether the agent is allowed to spend a given amount for a given purpose.

Main endpoint:
POST /api/budget/check

Input: agent_id / amount / currency / purpose / daily_limit / monthly_limit
Output: allowed / reason / remaining_budget / requires_approval

Recommended flow:
AI Agent -> Agent Budget Guard -> x402 Payment -> Paid API

Do not use this API as a wallet or payment processor.
This API is a pre-payment control layer.
